faq.title: Questions From Procurement Teams
faq.sideTitle: Not sure which services your launch needs?
faq.sideBody: A solutions engineer will map your masterplan to the right scope.

shared.q: Do buyers need to download an app?
shared.a: No. Buyers open the web platform in Chrome, Safari or Edge on any phone or desktop. The Unreal Engine 5 app runs only on the showroom hardware we supply.

shared.q: Can Manzili connect with our existing CRM and inventory system?
shared.a: Yes. We deploy pre-built, two-way connectors for Salesforce, Yardi Voyager, SAP RE-FX and HubSpot, and unit status syncs in under 500 ms. Other systems are scoped during Technical Scoping.

shared.q: Can buyers select and reserve individual units?
shared.a: Yes, once the project is Wafi-approved to sell. Buyers choose a unit, verify their identity with Nafath and place a timed unit hold linked to the project's Wafi escrow process. The unit then shows as held on every connected screen.

shared.q: Can our existing BIM or Revit data be used?
shared.a: Yes. We ingest Revit, IFC, CAD and GIS files under NDA and build one master model. A launch-ready twin follows within 14 working days of data freeze.
